jobs.title: Staff AI Product Manager
jobs.description:
**Company Description**

It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone—freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow— helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. We're building an AI-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started.

Join us to put AI to work for people.

 **Job Description**

**What you get to do in this role:**

* Own end to end product outcomes for AP AI Specialist end to end
* Build, don't just spec: prototype agent behavior, stand up demos, validate feasibility with engineering before it's a roadmap item
* Take an ambiguous problem (a customer pain point, an eval failure, a platform constraint) and figure out the right shape of the solution without waiting for it to be handed to you fully formed
* Define what "good" looks like for agent behavior — success criteria, eval scenarios, confidence thresholds — and use eval methodology as a real lever for product decisions, not a checkbox
* Partner with the platform/orchestration team on architecture tradeoffs (agent design, latency, oversight vs. automation), with enough technical depth to push back when something doesn't hold up
* Translate technical tradeoffs into plain language for engineering, architects, and execs — get in front of real users early to validate before building further
* Thrive in ambiguity: create structure where none exists, and pull the work forward through clarity and credibility rather than process

  
**Qualifications**

**To be successful in this role you have:**

* Experience in leveraging or critically thinking about how to integrate AI into work processes, decision-making, or problem-solving. This may include using AI-powered tools, automating workflows, analyzing AI-driven insights, or exploring AI's potential impact on the function or industry.
* 6-8+ years of PM experience, with recent hands-on work shipping AI/agentic features
* Comfortable prototyping and in the weeds with engineering: reviewing implementations, standing up demos, not just writing requirements
* Solid understanding of agent architectures — orchestration, tool use, multi-step reasoning — and how to translate that into a scoped roadmap
* Excellent communicator, able to align engineering, architecture, and stakeholders who all want different things
* AP/finance domain knowledge is a nice-to-have, not a requirement

FD21

 **Additional Information**

**Work Personas**

We approach our distributed world of work with flexibility and trust. Work personas (flexible, remote, or required in office) are categories that are assigned to ServiceNow employees depending on the nature of their work and their assigned work location. Learn more here. To determine eligibility for a work persona, ServiceNow may confirm the distance between your primary residence and the closest ServiceNow office using a third-party service.

**Equal Opportunity Employer**

ServiceNow is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, gender identity, veteran status, or any other category protected by law. In addition, all qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with legal requirements.

**Accommodations**

We strive to create an accessible and inclusive experience for all candidates. If you require a reasonable accommodation to complete any part of the application process, or are unable to use this online application and need an alternative method to apply, please contact globaltalentss@servicenow.com for assistance.

**Export Control Regulations**

For positions requiring access to controlled technology subject to export control regulations, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations (EAR), ServiceNow may be required to obtain export control approval from government authorities for certain individuals. All employment is contingent upon ServiceNow obtaining any export license or other approval that may be required by relevant export control authorities.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager - Tech, Shipment Technologies
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Amazon's Ship Tech (STS) team is responsible for key technology that enables planning, orchestration, and execution of transportation service to deliver billions of packages to Amazon.com customers globally. Our goal is to ensure the best delivery experience for customers across all geographies through a highly scalable, adaptive, and autonomous transportation network.  
  
We are looking for a product leader to join our Analytics team and drive a multi-year effort to build the next generation of transportation intelligence and decision support products. You will own the strategy and execution for data centralization, data maturity, insights generation, and decision support signals across our transportation network. Working closely with our data engineering teams, you will deliver high-impact analytics solutions that power better decisions for our business and operational teams. These solutions will drive improved on-time delivery, mitigate network and package level problems, and keep operators and customers informed of what is happening.  
  
The ideal candidate is capable of breaking down and solving complex problems, and has a strong will to get things done! You will work on real world problems on a global scale. You own your products end-to-end and influence the direction of our product and technology which impacts hundreds-of-millions of customers around the world. You are a hands-on, pragmatic problem solver that easily balances trade-offs between competing interests. You thrive in a fast-moving team environment where you are able to juggle complex dependencies and requirements while producing optimal solutions.  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Serve as the subject matter expert in transportation and logistics, data centralization, insights generation, and decision support, leveraging your deep domain knowledge to identify market trends, customer pain points, and opportunities for product enhancement
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including engineering, design, and customer success, to translate business requirements into technical specifications and drive the successful implementation of new product features and enhancements
* Develop a comprehensive product roadmap that aligns with the company's overall strategic objectives and effectively communicates it to stakeholders
* Continuously gather and analyze customer feedback, market intelligence, and industry insights to inform product decisions and ensure the delivery of high-value solutions
* Manage the product lifecycle, from ideation to launch, ensuring that milestones are met, risks are mitigated, and the product is delivered on time and within budget

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
* Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product
* Experience contributing to engineering discussions around technology decisions and strategy related to a product
* Experience managing technical products or online services
* Experience in representing and advocating for a variety of critical customers and stakeholders during executive-level prioritization and planning
* Experience defining roadmap strategy and prioritizing deliverables for your team products
* Experience owning feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, a related technical field or equivalent
* Experience in transportation operations and industry knowledge
* Experience understanding product and technical requirements and interfacing with Product/Technology teams
* Experience that includes strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and effective communication abilities
* Experience as a strong leader who can prioritize well, communicate clearly and effectively influence across cross-functional teams
* Experience bringing technology products to market in a fast-paced environment
* 6+ years of working as a Technical Product Manager experience

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience in using analytical tools, such as Tableau, Qlikview, QuickSight
* Experience in building and driving adoption of new tools
* Experience working directly with Engineers on product enhancements
* Experience in project management methodologies, business analysis, or process improvement
* 5+ years of supply chain operations and logistics experience

  
Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. jobs.description:
**Some careers open more doors than others.**

If you’re looking for a career that will unlock new opportunities, join HSBC and experience the possibilities. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.

**Business Descriptor:**

International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB) helps deliver on HSBC’s purpose of opening up a world of opportunity by providing our customers with borderless banking and world-class wealth management through best-in-class, mobile-first capabilities, and exceptional people. Our international network and breadth of expertise enable us to support individuals, families, business owners, investors, and entrepreneurs. International Wealth and Premier Banking provides a leading premium proposition through Premier Banking and, together with our Private Bank, are present across the world’s most important markets, booking centres, and corridors most valued by our clients. Our wealth offering is further enhanced through our best-in-class manufacturing capabilities in Asset Management and Insurance.

**Job Introduction**

The Premier Service Manager (PSM) role is a pivotal position within the International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB) branch network. IWPB is executing a multiyear growth strategy, pivoted on positioning as a global bank, committed to the long-term India growth story, and bringing to India its full scale of global capabilities. The business is poised for growth and is currently adding 20 more branches in phases to its existing fleet of 26 branches. This role is customer-facing, primarily servicing walk-in customers and managing their requirements to ensure satisfaction. The Premier proposition is a strategic priority for HSBC, and this role supports the Premier Relationship Managers (PRMs) in achieving their objectives by enhancing client-facing time and providing outstanding customer experiences.

**Principal Responsibilities**

  

* Provide high-quality support to a team of Premier Relationship Managers (PRMs) to achieve income plans through acquisition, cross-sales, retention, and growth.
* Act as the first point of contact for clients in the absence of PRMs, ensuring seamless service and relationship management.
* Build extensive knowledge of HSBC systems and procedures to effectively handle client needs and improve process efficiencies.
* Proactively identify opportunities to enhance customer service and process efficiencies.
* Ensure clients consistently receive professional, premium service that exceeds expectations.
* Maintain high standards of control and operational practices in line with HSBC’s expectations.
* Enhance customer confidence in HSBC’s Global Premier proposition through systematic and regular communication.
* Attain key performance indicators (KPIs) by acquiring new customers and promoting credit card and general insurance products.
* Meet KPIs for referrals and cross-selling opportunities.

**Education Qualifications / Certifications and Requirements**

* Graduate Degree
* Minimum of two to five years of experience in a customer service or banking environment.
* Holistic understanding of branch operations and processes.
* Sound understanding of the company’s customer service requirements.

**Other Requirements (Knowledge and Experience)**

* Exceptional and updated knowledge of banking products, systems, and processes.
* Well-organized with a professional image and extraordinary business focus.
* Strong customer orientation and ability to provide exemplary service.
* Self-motivated with the drive to overachieve on goals and targets.
* Ability to build close relationships with team members and skillful association with support group colleagues.

**Skills**

* **Exceptional Communication Skills:** Ability to convey information clearly and effectively across various channels.
* **Strong Interpersonal Skills:** Capable of building and maintaining positive relationships with colleagues and clients.
* **Highly Organized:** Demonstrates meticulous attention to detail and efficient task management.
* **Collaborative Team Player:** Works well within a team, contributing to collective goals and fostering a supportive environment.
* **Proactive and Efficient:** Acts swiftly and decisively to achieve objectives, ensuring timely completion of tasks.

**Regulatory Certifications:**

FEDAI, NISM (Demat), and IRDA certifications are preferred or should be obtained / transferred to HSBC mapping within 3 to 6 months of onboarding.

**Additional Notes :**

  

* Familiarity with AI-enabled tools is an advantage.
* Mandatory to successfully complete Anti-Money Laundering and Sanctions training and post-course assessment, as required.

As an employee, you are required to perform your duties in a professional capacity exercising independent judgement, discretion and decision-making authority in planning, organising, directing work, supervising and appraising the work of team members, as applicable; and taking accountability for delivery outcomes. You will represent the organization with relevant internal and external stakeholders. You will allocate and prioritize work, provide direction and feedback, manage team capacity and leave in line with policy as applicable.

You’ll achieve more at HSBC.

HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment.

Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

Job Description
  
  
Specialist, Business Analyst – AI Content Creation (Content Creation Storage)
  
  
The Opportunity
  
  

* Based in Hyderabad, join a global healthcare biopharma company and be part of a 130- year legacy of success backed by ethical integrity, forward momentum, and an inspiring mission to achieve new milestones in global healthcare.
* Be part of an organization driven by digital technology and data-backed approaches that support a diversified portfolio of prescription medicines, vaccines, and animal health products.
* Drive innovation and execution excellence. Be a part of a team with passion for using data, analytics, and insights to drive decision-making, and which creates custom software, allowing us to tackle some of the worlds greatest health threats.

Our Technology Centers focus on creating a space where teams can come together to deliver business solutions that save and improve lives. An integral part of our company’s IT operating model, Tech Centers are globally distributed locations where each IT division has employees to enable our digital transformation journey and drive business outcomes. These locations, in addition to the other sites, are essential to supporting our business and strategy.
  
  
A focused group of leaders in each Tech Center helps to ensure we can manage and improve each location, from investing in growth, success, and well-being of our people, to making sure colleagues from each IT division feel a sense of belonging to managing critical emergencies. And together, we must leverage the strength of our team to collaborate globally to optimize connections and share best practices across the Tech Centers.
  
  
About Digital Human Health (DHH)
  
Digital Human Health (DHH) connects technology, data, and people to enable and accelerate Human Health business across global markets. DHH supports commercial and medical teams by delivering customer-centric digital platforms, data capabilities, and technology-enabled operating models that enable flexible go-to-market approaches, actionable insights, and personalized customer experiences in a regulated environment.
  
Within DHH, the Content Creation Storage pillar of Digital Content Customer Experience (DCCE) builds the platforms and capabilities that help Human Health create compliant, on-brand content faster. As part of the Content Accelerator, the pillar is moving content creation from manual production to AI-generated content that is built to brand and compliance standards from the start, combining agentic content creation platform, Adobe capabilities (including Adobe Brand Intelligence and Adobe Firefly), design system, and AEM/DAM foundations.
  
  
Role Purpose
  
Act as hands-on business and product partner for AI-enabled content creation, working closely with business users and vendor teams to shape, test, and evolve GenAI and agentic capabilities, and building the internal knowledge needed to confidently own custom components as the platform landscape evolves.

* Support the AI Content creation workstream: experiment design, requirements, testing, and assessment of where Adobe capabilities can replace or complement custom-built components.
* Build working ownership of custom agentic components. Understand how they work, maintain requirements and backlog, and guide their evolution with engineering and vendor teams.
* Support the Adobe Firefly rollout across Human Health: access and onboarding inputs, playbook and enablement content, usage reporting, and user feedback loops.
* Work closely with content creators, brand teams, and reviewers to capture real feedback, prioritize the most important items, and turn them into fast, practical iterations.
* Flex across adjacent workstreams in the pillar (e.g., design system, guardrails/rules, AEM/DAM) as priorities shift.

Key Responsibilities
  
Business Analysis Product Ownership Support
  
  

* Translate business and workflow needs into clear requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria for AI-enabled content creation capabilities.
* Maintain and prioritize backlogs in partnership with the Product Owner; support sprint planning, refinement, and release readiness.
* Map current-state and future-state content creation workflows, identifying where AI and agents add value and where human review remains essential.
* Facilitate UAT with business, brand, and compliance stakeholders; track defects, gaps, and fixes through to closure.

Hands-on GenAI Agentic Delivery (Embedded with the Business)
  
  

* Work hands-on with GenAI and agentic tools to test, configure, and validate capabilities (e.g., prompts, agent inputs/outputs, brand rules, assembly and validation steps).
* Sit close to business users during pilots and early rollout: observe real usage, unblock issues quickly, and feed priority learnings back into the backlog.
* Design and run structured experiments with clear scope, success criteria, test assets, and results (e.g., accuracy, false-flag rate, turnaround time, rework).
* Build a working understanding of component architecture, integrations, and APIs to have informed discussions with engineering and vendors.

Platform Vendor Collaboration (Adobe and Partners)
  
  

* Serve as a day-to-day contact for Adobe and implementation partners on ABI and Firefly: align on scope, prerequisites, dependencies, and timelines.
* Assess build vs. buy trade-offs for components (custom vs. platform capability) and document recommendations with risks and dependencies.
* Review vendor deliverables (playbooks, guides, configurations) to confirm fit needs and governance.

Documentation, Governance Communication
  
  

* Maintain a clear source of truth (e.g., Confluence, JIRA) covering requirements, decisions, test results, and component documentation.

jobs.title: Senior ABAP Developer
jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This Position reports to:

IS Manager

In this role, you will build and support the SAP ABAP solutions that run our business as one of the first developers on a new central development team. Each day, you will write production code in SAP ECC and S/4HANA: reports, enhancements, interfaces, forms, and posting logic. You will work directly with the business users who depend on that code. You will also showcase your experience by taking on work across Finance, Logistics, Operations and Sales as priorities shift, and by bringing practical clean core judgment to our S/4HANA journey. You will learn and use the agentic AI development platforms the team is adopting, such as Nova Intelligence and Conduct.

In this role, you will report to the ABAP Development Lead, work as an individual contributor, and have no people management responsibilities.

The work model for the role is: Hybrid, minimum 3 days per week in the office. #LI-Hybrid

This role contributes to the Information Systems Core Business Applications (ERP) team, Electrification business area Installation Products division, in India. Main stakeholders are business users and project leads in Finance, Logistics, Operations, and Sales; the ABAP Development Lead; functional consultants; the SAP BTP and integration teams; and SAP Basis.

**You will be mainly accountable for:**
---------------------------------------

  

* Building and finishing: delivering production ABAP in ECC every week, closing your commitments on the date you gave, chasing what is blocked, and following up after go-live until the problem is really solved.
* Bridging to S/4HANA: contributing to S/4HANA Public Cloud stabilization and Private Cloud planning using CDS, RAP and ABAP Cloud, and choosing standard extensibility over classic enhancement where it fits.
* Working directly with the business: sitting with the people who have the problem, understanding the process and configuration behind it, and building what they actually need.
* Working to the team standard: following coding guidelines, ABAP Test Cockpit checks, code review and transport discipline, reviewing colleagues' code, and using AI-assisted development within the team's rules.

**Our team dynamics**

You will become part of a small, collaborative team where everyone contributes and supports one another. AI is part of how we work, and we will help you get started if you are new to it. Done means it is being used by the business, not just transported, and a straightforward “I don’t know yet” is welcome.

**Qualifications for the role**

  

* You have more than 8 years of SAP development experience, with deep current ABAP knowledge in ECC, including enhancements, IDoc, RFC/BAPI, OData, and REST interfaces, plus performance optimization.
* You show a consistent ability to deliver production outcomes that can be measured, including initiatives that were delayed before you inherited them.
* You have practical SAP S/4HANA experience, including CDS views and a solid understanding of clean core principles.
* You enjoy working directly with business users and understanding the process and configuration behind a requirement, not only the specification.
* You have established skills in working to a shared development standard, including code review, ABAP Test Cockpit, and transport discipline, in onshore/offshore or multi-team environments.
* You are open to AI-assisted development and ready to learn agentic SAP platforms such as Nova Intelligence or Conduct. Prior AI experience.
* You are comfortable using English in both conversation and writing.

**What's in it for you?**

You will work on code that keeps a global business running and help shape how a new central team builds. You’ll have direct experience with the latest agentic AI tools for SAP development, along with guidance as you learn them. You can grow into a techno-functional or value stream role, or technical leadership, and we will support you on either path.

**More about us (Mandatory)**

At ABB, we help shape digital industries and power grids while supporting sustainable change in a wide range of sectors. Our division is recognized as a trusted partner delivering forward-looking insights that fuel sustainable growth. We cultivate a workplace that values diversity, inclusion, and belonging across gender, ethnicity, LGBTQ+ identities, abilities, and generations, so every voice is heard.

We look forward to receiving your application (documents submitted in English are appreciated).

If you want to discover more about ABB, take another look at our website www.abb.com.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. We welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact? Apply today or visit www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

Recruitment Fraud Warning

ABB never asks for payment from job applicants. All genuine job offers follow a formal application and interview process.

View current job openings and apply at: https://careers.abb/global/en/home

For more information, read our full fraud warning notice at: https://global.abb/group/en/careers/how-to-apply/fraud-warning

jobs.title: Product Owner
jobs.description:
**Project Role :** Product Owner  
**Project Role Description :** Drives the vision for the product by being the voice of the customer, following a human-centered design approach. Shapes and manages the product roadmap and product backlog and ensures the product team consistently deliver on the clients needs and wants. Validates and tests ideas through recurrent feedback loops to ensure knowledge discovery informs timely direction changes.
  
**Must have skills :** Software Product Management  
**Good to have skills :** NA  
Minimum **7.5** year(s) of experience is required  
**Educational Qualification :** 15 years full time education  
  
Summary:
  
We are seeking a Senior Product Manager to lead the strategy, roadmap, and execution of our Data Ingestion and Customer Onboarding experiences. This role is responsible for defining how customer data is collected, transformed, validated, and activated across our products, ensuring customers achieve value quickly and efficiently.  
  
The successful candidate will develop a deep understanding of our products, platform strategy, customer needs, and company objectives to drive a cohesive vision for onboarding and data ingestion capabilities. They will work cross-functionally with Product Management, Engineering, Design, Customer Success, Professional Services, and Partner teams to deliver scalable solutions that improve customer adoption and operational efficiency.
  
Roles & Responsibilities:
  
Product Strategy & Vision  
  
Define and own the product vision and strategy for data ingestion, onboarding experiences.  
Develop a roadmap aligned with company objectives, customer needs, and platform priorities.  
Evaluate trade-offs, dependencies, technical constraints, and alternative approaches to maximize business value.  
Establish short-term and long-term priorities while balancing customer commitments, strategic investments, and technical debt.  
Partner with leadership to ensure alignment across product portfolios and business units.  
  
Customer Onboarding & User Journey Ownership  
  
Own the end-to-end onboarding experience, from customer setup through successful product adoption.  
Identify friction points in onboarding workflows and drive improvements that reduce implementation effort and time-to-value.  
Understand customer data requirements, integration patterns, and operational workflows.  
Collaborate with Professional Services, Customer Success, and Support teams to continuously improve customer onboarding outcomes.  
Define onboarding metrics and success criteria to measure adoption, activation, and customer health.  
  
Product Execution  
  
Translate business requirements into detailed product requirements, user stories, epics, and acceptance criteria.  
Manage and prioritize the product backlog based on business value, customer impact, technical dependencies, and strategic priorities.  
Work closely with Engineering teams throughout the development lifecycle.  
Participate in sprint planning, backlog refinement, release planning, and feature validation.  
Ensure delivered capabilities meet user needs and align with product strategy.  
Data Ingestion & Platform Capabilities  
  
Define capabilities for data ingestion, mapping, validation, transformation, monitoring, and governance.  
Understand modern integration technologies, APIs, connectors, ETL/ELT processes, and SaaS application integrations.  
Drive solutions that enable efficient onboarding of customer data from multiple source systems.  
Partner with platform teams to establish scalable and reusable ingestion services and experiences.  
Define approaches for handling data quality, exceptions, observability, and onboarding automation.  
  
Stakeholder Management  
  
Collaborate with Product Managers across the portfolio to ensure consistency and alignment across products.  
Act as the primary liaison between business stakeholders and engineering teams.  
Build strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders to gather feedback and drive alignment.  
Communicate priorities, roadmap decisions, and product direction effectively at all levels of the organization.  
  
Customer Engagement & Product Evangelism  
  
Conduct customer interviews and gather insights to validate product direction.  
Demonstrate product capabilities to customers, prospects, partners, and internal stakeholders.  
Support customer workshops, onboarding reviews, and strategic discussions.  
Present roadmap updates and product outcomes to leadership and cross-functional teams.
  
Professional & Technical Skills:
  
5+ years of Product Management experience in a SaaS, enterprise software, platform, or data-centric environment.  
Strong understanding of software development processes and Agile methodologies.  
Experience building and managing product roadmaps.  
Experience writing detailed requirements, user stories, epics, and acceptance criteria.  
Familiarity with Jira, Azure DevOps, or similar product management tools.  
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to evaluate complex trade-offs.  
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.  
Ability to work effectively across Engineering, Design, Operations, Customer Success, and Product organizations.
  
Additional Information:
  
Experience with data onboarding, data integration, data management, APIs.  
Experience designing customer onboarding and implementation experiences.  
Familiarity with enterprise software ecosystems such as ERP, CRM, eCommerce, procurement, or finance platforms.  
Understanding of customer journey mapping and user experience principles.  
Experience with cloud-based platforms and modern SaaS architectures.  
Knowledge of data governance, data quality, and observability concepts.  
Experience supporting customer demonstrations, workshops, and enterprise implementations.

**Experience:** 2 to 6 Years

**About The Smarketers**

The Smarketers is a B2B marketing agency that works with technology companies to help them build their brand, generate demand, and grow their business.

We work with clients across SaaS, IT Services, Manufacturing, Industrial Automation, Telecom, Healthcare, ERP, FinTech, and other technology-driven B2B industries.

Content is one of the key pillars of what we do. We create blogs, eBooks, whitepapers, case studies, website content, social media content, brochures, reports, video scripts, and other marketing and sales content.

**Do you understand technology and have a flair for creative writing?Can you turn complex B2B technology and business topics into content that people want to read?**

You will work across different industries and need to understand the client's business, products, technology, customers, industry, competitors, and positioning before creating content. jobs.title: Senior Staff Product Manager - Data Protection
jobs.description:
**Our Company**
  
  
At Teradata, we believe that people thrive when empowered with better information. Teradata Autonomous Knowledge Platform activates enterprise intelligence by unifying data, knowledge and business context to achieve tangible outcomes. With Teradata, organizations can provide agents with full context for impact when it matters. Our solution lets businesses connect and scale on premises, in the cloud, or through a hybrid approach. Teradata delivers real business value with AI.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**
  
  
In this role, you will serve as a product leader driving Teradata’s data protection product management strategy and execution across our global portfolio. You will define and influence how Teradata delivers resilient data protection for the world’s most sensitive enterprise data; spanning backup and recovery, replication, disaster recovery, business continuity, and cyber resilience.
  
  
Your impact will be shaping how customers meet aggressive RTO and RPO targets at Petabyte scale ensuring reliable backup, rapid recovery, and continuous data availability across hybrid and multi-cloud environments. You will accelerate the delivery of the Enterprise data protection and resilience roadmap, balancing innovation with performance, reliability, and compliance.
  
  
Success in this role will be measured by delivering enterprise-grade data protection and resilience solutions for hybrid and multi-cloud deployments, differentiating Teradata and unlocking measurable customer value while preserving scalability, reliability, and cost-efficiency.
  
  
**Who You Will Work With**
On our team, we collaborate with customers, engineering, cloud infrastructure, security operations, governance, field teams, and UX functions to bring next-generation data protection and resilience capabilities into Teradata’s enterprise ecosystem. We are responsible for the product vision, roadmap, and execution of backup, recovery, and resilience initiatives, ensuring they meet both business and technical objectives.
  
  
**What Makes You a Qualified Candidate**

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, engineering, or related field.
* 12+ years of product management experience, including 6+ years leading data protection, backup and recovery, or disaster recovery products at enterprise scale, including Managed Service Providers
* Deep technical expertise across the data protection stack: backup software and storage platforms, deduplication and compression, snapshot management, replication topologies, immutable and air-gapped storage, ransomware recovery, DR orchestration, and RPO/RTO optimization across on-premises, cloud, and hybrid environments.
* Proven success embedding backup, recovery, and resilience capabilities into enterprise data platforms at petabyte scale, with measurable improvements to customer SLA attainment and recovery confidence.
* Demonstrated knowledge of hybrid and multi-cloud architectures and their impact on backup strategy, data residency, sovereignty, storage tiering, and cost optimization.
* Exceptional communication skills with the ability to articulate data protection product strategy to both technical and executive audiences.
* Track record of customer engagement, market analysis, and competitive benchmarking against leading backup and data protection vendors and native cloud provider capabilities.

**What You Will Bring**

* Expertise architecting enterprise backup topologies, cyber resiliency and Agentic AI data protection strategies across on-premises, cloud, and hybrid environments, with a focus on minimizing recovery time
* Hands-on knowledge of leading backup and recovery platforms (e. g. , Rubrik, Veeam, Cohesity, Commvault, Zerto, NetBackup) and cloud-native backup services (AWS Backup, Azure Backup, Google Cloud Backup and DR).
* Ability to connect backup and recovery strategy to modern AI/ML and analytics workloads, including protecting training datasets, model checkpoints, feature stores, and data pipelines against corruption, accidental deletion, and ransomware.
* A strong understanding of backup retention policy design, covering lifecycle management, legal hold, eDiscovery readiness, and compliance-driven retention schedules for regulated data classes (PII, PHI, PCI) across tiered and archival storage.
* Vision to anticipate industry trends, next-generation backup architectures, AI-driven anomaly detection for data corruption, and data sovereignty mandates and position Teradata’s data protection offerings as differentiated and enterprise-ready.

**Why We Think You’ll Love Teradata**
We prioritize a people-first culture because we know our people are at the very heart of our success. We embrace a flexible work model because we trust our people to make decisions about how, when, and where they work. We focus on well-being because we care about our people and their ability to thrive both personally and professionally. We are an anti-racist company because our dedication to Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion is more than a statement. It is a deep commitment to doing the work to foster an equitable environment that celebrates people for all of who they are.
  
  
Teradata invites all identities and backgrounds in the workplace. We work with deliberation and intent to ensure we are cultivating collaboration and inclusivity across our global organization. ​ We are proud to be an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, color, ancestry, religion, creed, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, breastfeeding, or related conditions), national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, medical condition, genetic information, gender identity or expression, military and veteran status, or any other legally protected status.

****Principal Product Manager****

**About The Role**
Cornerstone's Intelligence+ portfolio is building the workforce intelligence layer for the world's largest organizations — connecting skills, roles, people, and external labor market data into a single decision-making fabric. At the heart of this is a family of analytics and insight products that turn complex, multi-source data into trusted answers for enterprise leaders.

You'll work in close partnership with the data science team that owns the underlying LMI models.
  
  
This is a senior IC role for a PM who has built data analytics products — not just shipped software. You know what it takes to earn user trust in a number on a screen: data quality, methodology transparency, the right visualization for the right question, and AI/ML that is explainable rather than magical.
  
  
**In this role you will...**

* Own how the Labor Market Intelligence offering is embedded into the workforce intelligence product — shaping the roadmap for LMI-powered experiences from data ingestion through customer-facing analytics.
* Partner with data science on ML models, taxonomy mapping, normalization, and inference — defining evaluation criteria and making explainability a product requirement, not an afterthought.

* Design insight and visualization experiences that make complex workforce and market data legible and decision-ready.
* Define the analytics measurement framework for the product itself: adoption, insight quality, and demonstrable customer value.
* Work directly with enterprise customers to shape requirements, run pilots, and convert feedback into product direction.
* Drive GTM readiness with field enablement, packaging, and positioning — including consultative, services-led delivery models.

* 8+ years of product management experience with wide-ranging expertise, operating at Principal/Lead scope — you determine methods and approaches on new initiatives independently and guide the work of others.

**Nice To Have**

* Experience with LLM-based features and agentic product experiences.
* Prior experience in HCM, talent intelligence, or people analytics platforms.
* Exposure to compliance considerations for AI products (EU AI Act, data privacy).

**Why This Role**
You'll own a product with direct executive visibility, an enterprise customer base, and a central role in Cornerstone's AI strategy — shaping how enterprises understand and act on their workforce and the market around it.
  
  
**Our Culture**
Spark Greatness. Shatter Boundaries. Share Success. Are you ready? Because here, right now – is where the future of work is happening. Where curious disruptors and change innovators like you are helping communities and customers enable everyone – anywhere – to learn, grow and advance. To be better tomorrow than they are today.
  
  
**Who We Are**
At Cornerstone, we believe in AI that works in the service of people, amplifying their judgment to drive high-performing, future-ready organizations forward. Cornerstone Workforce AI™, the intelligence platform for workforce readiness, brings together workforce and labor market data into a proprietary Cornerstone People Graph™, translating signals into intelligence, targeting learning where it matters, developing critical skills, and surfacing hidden talent. Delivered as an open, enterprise platform across whatever application your people work in every day, Cornerstone Workforce AI is built for scale, security, and trust, with certified AI guardrails. As an industry leader, Cornerstone is helping approximately 7,000 organizations, 140M+ users, across 186 countries build continuous workforce readiness.

* Continuously looking for ways to improve our way of working and collaborating with our other product managers to ensure we are always growing

  

**Your qualifications**

**Adaptability and Flexibility:** Stay adaptable in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, effectively managing changing priorities and requirements while maintaining focus on project objectives.

Joining Taazaa Tech means thriving in a dynamic, innovative environment with competitive compensation and performance-based incentives. Ariqt Global Technologies (AGT) is a fast-growing software services company dedicated to delivering innovative solutions across financial technology, mobile applications, Artificial Intelligence (AI), cybersecurity, and other cutting-edge technology domains. Our team thrives on innovation, creativity, and a commitment to excellence, building impactful software solutions for clients across international markets.
  
  
Join us in shaping the future of technology by translating innovative ideas into successful software products and AI-powered solutions.
  
  
Role Overview
  
  
We are seeking a highly motivated and results-driven Software Product Owner & Project Manager with hands-on experience managing AI-driven projects to bridge the gap between business requirements and technical execution.
  
  
The ideal candidate will have experience managing the complete lifecycle of software and AI projects, from requirement gathering and product planning to development, testing, deployment, and delivery. This role requires strong product ownership, project management, problem-solving, and stakeholder management skills, along with the ability to collaborate effectively with AI/ML engineers, software developers, and cross-functional teams.

jobs.description:
The Data Platform Product Owner is responsible for helping define, prioritize, and drive the evolution of the enterprise data platform as a product. The role will help ensure that the platform is designed to address business needs and is tailored to the organization structure and scale, while simultaneously being an advocate for data-driven decision-making and the enablement of the platform across the organization.

Acting as the bridge between business domains, data platform teams, and engineering, the Product Owner translates business needs into clear platform requirements, defines priorities, and ensures delivery of capabilities that maximize business value. The role is accountable for maintaining a clear product vision, roadmap, and backlog for the platform, balancing strategic initiatives (e.g., data products, governance, marketplace, migration) with operational stability and efficiency.

The Product Owner works closely with platform engineering, data architects, other Product Owners and DevOps teams to ensure that platform capabilities are delivered in a standardized, reusable, and scalable manner. They also collaborate with business stakeholders and product teams to define how the platform is consumed, ensuring clarity in delivery models, ownership, and support structures.

A key responsibility of the role is to establish and enforce ways of working for the platform, including intake processes, prioritization frameworks, and governance standards. This includes ensuring that data product ownership, privacy-by-design, and compliance requirements are consistently embedded across all platform use cases.

As a key figure in a global, organizational-scale software initiative, the Data Platform Product Owner must be a promoter of the Agile mindset and a champion of continuous delivery and feedback, cooperating with the DevOps teams to implement practices that generate incremental and steady feature delivery at scale that adapts quickly to feedback and business changes.

The role contributes to the continuous improvement of the platform by identifying gaps, driving enhancements, and aligning platform evolution with broader strategic initiatives such as data mesh adoption, data governance, and cloud transformation.

Working closely with delivery leads, architects, and business product owners, the Data Platform Product Owner ensures a clear and transparent roadmap, enabling high-quality, secure, and scalable solutions that support both current operations and future growth.

* Ensure transparency on capacity, trade-offs, and prioritization decisions.

**Roboyo AI is a category shaper in Applied AI and Agentic Automation.**

We help leading enterprises move from automation projects and AI experiments into governed, production-grade systems that execute real work across workflows, processes, products and services.

 

Our heritage is in scaled enterprise automation; our future is Applied AI and Agentic Automation: autonomous agents, AI engineering squads, process orchestration, data and knowledge foundations, and human-in-the-loop governance embedded deeply into how our clients operate.

 

We are not here to sell AI theatre. We are here to turn AI into working systems, measurable outcomes and repeatable transformation programs.

 

**About the role**

This is an end-to-end ownership role. The
**Senior Business Analyst**
(BSA) is accountable for the business-facing thread of an automation or AI initiative from first stakeholder conversation to post-production stabilisation. You will run process discovery and feasibility assessment, define and baseline requirements, partner with architects and developers through build, own functional and user acceptance testing, support go-live and hypercare, and hand over a fully documented, measurable solution to the client and support teams. You are expected to operate independently on complex processes, mentor junior analysts, and be the person the client trusts to tell them what is genuinely automatable and what is not.

 

**Key Responsibilities**

 

* Lead structured discovery workshops, stakeholder interviews, job shadowing and process walkthroughs with business SMEs to capture the true operating process, including exceptions, workarounds and undocumented tribal knowledge.

* Perform automation feasibility and complexity assessment; qualify or disqualify candidate processes against standardisation, rule-clarity, volume, stability and data-quality criteria, and have the confidence to recommend against automation where the business case does not hold.

* Build the business case: quantify AS-IS effort, volumes, FTE cost, error rates and cycle times; model expected benefit, ROI, payback period and effort estimate, and present it to client sponsors for funding approval.

* Capture process metrics and prepare the Process Qualification / Assessment output, including pipeline prioritisation where multiple candidates compete for the same delivery capacity.

* Use Process Mining and Task Mining outputs where available to validate stated process behaviour against actual system event data, rather than relying solely on stakeholder recall.

* Conduct deep-dive "As-Is" analysis to design optimized "To-Be" states, ensuring processes are not just automated, but architected for peak efficiency.

* Author comprehensive Process Design Documents (PDDs) and partner on Solution Designs (SDDs) to ensure absolute logic clarity and traceability.

* Produce end-to-end process maps and flow diagrams (BPMN / Visio / Lucid), covering the happy path, every business exception, every system exception and the defined handling for each.

* Define and baseline detailed functional and non-functional requirements, acceptance criteria, business rules, data dictionaries, input/output specifications and in-scope / out-of-scope boundaries; drive formal sign-off from the process owner before build begins.

* Own the Requirements Traceability Matrix (RTM) so that every requirement is traceable through design, build, test case and production release.

* Identify and document the AS-IS to TO-BE process re-engineering opportunities, eliminating waste before automating rather than automating an inefficient process as-is.

* Contribute to pre-sales and solutioning activity - discovery for prospects, effort estimation and proposal input - where the account requires it.

 

**Deliverables Owned by This Role**

 

* Process Assessment / Qualification Document and automation business case with ROI model.

* As-Is and To-Be process maps and detailed process flow diagrams.

* Process Definition Document (PDD) and contribution to the Solution Design Document (SDD).

* Functional and non-functional requirements specification with acceptance criteria and business rules.

* Test strategy, test scenarios, test cases, UAT pack and signed UAT closure report.

* Exception handling and business continuity procedure.

* End-user training material, SOPs and user guides.

* Support runbook, escalation matrix and knowledge-transfer pack for handover.

* Post-implementation benefit realisation report.

* 5+ years of Business Analysis experience with a dedicated focus on

  , or AI-driven application engineering, including at least 2 years in a senior or lead analyst capacity.

* Proven understanding of modern AI architectures, with the ability to design workflows that incorporate LLMs, API integrations, and unstructured data processing.

Veeva Systems is a mission-driven organization and pioneer in industry cloud, helping life sciences companies bring therapies to patients faster. As one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies in history, we surpassed $3B in revenue in our last fiscal year with extensive growth potential ahead.
  
  
At the heart of Veeva are our values: Do the Right Thing, Customer Success, Employee Success, and Speed. We're not just any public company – we made history in 2021 by becoming a public benefit corporation (PBC), legally bound to balancing the interests of customers, employees, society, and investors.
  
  
As a Work Anywhere company, we support your flexibility to work from home or in the office, so you can thrive in your ideal environment.
  
  
Join us in transforming the life sciences industry, committed to making a positive impact on its customers, employees, and communities.
  
  
The Role
  
  
Join Veeva’s journey on building the industry cloud for life sciences. We are bringing to market a modern cloud solution designed to optimize laboratories with increased efficiency and productivity by streamlining processes. Join the team that will partner with our customers to implement one of Veeva’s newest products in Quality Cloud - Veeva LIMS.
  
  
Passionate about bringing disruptive technology to customers and have novel ideas for successful GxP software implementation? This role will allow you to help our clients to drive new product adoption through successful implementations.
  
  
This is a remote, full-time permanent role with Veeva. For a candidate this is a customer-facing role and we have no work location requirement, if you are in close proximity to an airport and able to meet future travel requirements.
  
  
Qualified candidates must be legally authorized to be employed in India. Veeva does not provide sponsorship for employment visas for this position.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Participate in projects at life sciences companies designing and deploying Quality & Manufacturing applications
* Conduct Workshops, Collaborate with QA, business, and IT teams on activities to related to requirements gathering, and Process design modeling of the Veeva Qualitysuite
* Gather and translate business requirements into detailed user stories or functional specifications (where applicable), and documentation (e.g., Workflow diagram, User Stories or FS, etc.).
* Quality/Content management solution design, prototyping and documentation
* Leverage enablement of out-of-the-box or best practices approach to solution strategy
* Contribute to sprint planning and Agile methodology to drive continuous delivery.
* Represent Professional Services across multiple engagements and workstreams (e.g., solution design and configuration, data migration, systems integration, etc.)
* Ensure customer success from the beginning to the end of the engagement life cycle

**Requirements**

* Bachelor's Degree in Life science, computer science, or related degree
* 5+ years as a Business / Functional Analyst with Veeva eQMS application in a regulated life sciences/pharma environment
* Strong understanding of Veeva eQMS, with a particular focus on Deviation, Change Control, Lab Investigations (OOS/OOT), Audits and SQM processes
* Hands-on experience with Veeva tasks (e.g., Process configuration, user management, metadata, workflows).
* Solid analytical and great interpersonal skills
* Excellent communication skills (written and verbal)
* Ability to act with speed to understand business requirements and willingness to "roll up your sleeves" to design and implement a solution

****Nice to Have****

* Knowledge of Quality and Manufacturing operations within the Life Sciences, Pharmaceutical, Biotech industry, and

**Perks & Benefits**

* Health & wellness programs
* Life Assurance
* Veeva charitable giving program
* Additional annual leave over Christmas break

Veeva’s headquarters is located in the San Francisco Bay Area with offices in more than 15 countries around the world.
  
  
Veeva is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, religion, national origin or ancestry, age, disability, marital status, pregnancy, protected veteran status, protected genetic information, political affiliation, or any other characteristics protected by local laws, regulations, or ordinances.

jobs.title: Oliver Wyman - Senior Business Analyst (SQL & Excel) - Hyderabad
jobs.description:
**Oliver Wyman's Data and Analytics team is looking to hire a Senior Business Analyst for our Hyderabad office.**
**OW DNA Overview**
The Oliver Wyman DNA is a distinguished centre of excellence for business analytics and data analytics within Oliver Wyman. This group leverages data and information to provide business insights to Oliver Wyman consulting teams driving positive outcomes and tangible impact for Oliver Wyman’s clients. The group combines cutting edge data science expertise with core consulting expertise to augment engagement teams with analytical firepower to deliver outstanding results.
  
  
**Role Summary:**
The Senior Business Analyst will independently manage analytical workstreams, working closely with business stakeholders to translate requirements into structured analyses and actionable insights. This role requires strong business acumen, advanced SQL and Excel capabilities, and the ability to interpret financial statements. The Senior Analyst will lead medium to large analytical modules, guide junior analysts, and ensure clarity and quality across deliverables. They will play a key role in connecting data to commercial and operational performance, especially within manufacturing environments
  
  
**Experience & Skills Requirements:**

* Strong analytical thinking with the ability to independently structure and solve business problems
* Strong business acumen and the ability to connect analytical findings to commercial or operational impact
* Ability to interpret financial statements and analyze trends in revenue, costs, margins, assets, and cash flows
* Excellent communication skills to work directly with stakeholders and clarify requirements
* 4+ years of proven experience with SQL and Excel (non-negotiable), including advanced queries and modeling
* Experience in KPI modeling, pricing analysis, operational efficiency, or supply chain analytics
* Ability to guide junior analysts by reviewing their queries, models, and thought process
* Understanding of data structures, relational tables, joins, and query optimization techniques
* Prior experience in manufacturing analytics is strongly preferred
* Ability to work in a fast-paced environment with multiple tasks
* Strong written and verbal communication skills with demonstrated ability to interact effectively with all levels of stakeholders (both internal and external)
* Willingness to travel as required to meet client needs

**Key Requirements:**

* Lead analytical workstreams using advanced SQL and Excel methods
* Analyze and interpret financial statements to uncover improvement opportunities or performance gaps
* Break down ambiguous business questions into structured analytical tasks and clear deliverables.
* Estimate effort based on inputs, expected value, and data complexity
* Prepare executive-ready summaries that articulate insights clearly and persuasively
* Ensure data governance, consistency, and adherence to analytical best practices
* Facilitate requirement-gathering sessions with clients and translate needs into analytical plans
* Build sophisticated operational, commercial, or financial models to support strategic decisions
* Mentor Analysts in query-writing, modelling, and business understanding
* Identify risks early, propose mitigation steps, and maintain clear communication on progress

Oliver Wyman is a business of Marsh (NYSE: MRSH), a global leader in risk, reinsurance and capital, people and investments, and management consulting, advising clients in 130 countries. With annual revenue of over $27 billion and more than 95,000 colleagues, Marsh helps build the confidence to thrive through the power of perspective. For more information, visit oliverwyman.com, or follow us on LinkedIn and X.
  
  
Marsh is committed to embracing a diverse, inclusive and flexible work environment. We aim to attract and retain the best people and embrace diversity of age, background, caste, disability, ethnic origin, family duties, gender orientation or expression, gender reassignment, marital status, nationality, parental status, personal or social status, political affiliation, race, religion and beliefs, sex/gender, sexual orientation or expression, skin color, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.
  
  
Marsh is committed to hybrid work, which includes the flexibility of working remotely and the collaboration, connections and professional development benefits of working together in the office. All Marsh colleagues are expected to be in their local office or working onsite with clients at least three days per week. Office-based teams will identify at least one “anchor day” per week on which their full team will be together in person.

jobs.description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
If you are energized by solving complex business problems through technology and want to help shape the future of global tax delivery, consider joining the US Tax Transformation technology team. This is an opportunity to play a meaningful role in Deloitte’s digital transformation by helping bring innovative products, capabilities, and experiences to life for our tax professionals and stakeholders around the world. You will work at the intersection of business, technology, and execution—partnering across teams to support high-impact initiatives that improve how we operate, serve clients, and create value at scale.
  
  
Deloitte Tax Services India Private Limited commenced operations in June 2004. Since then, nearly all of the Deloitte Tax LLP (“Deloitte Tax”) U.S. service lines have obtained support through Deloitte Tax in India. Deloitte Tax in India offers you opportunities to learn U.S. taxation, a much sought-after career option.
  
  
At Deloitte, we are leading clients through the tax transformation taking place in the marketplace. We offer a broad range of fully integrated tax services and add greater impact to clients by combining technology and tax technical resources to uncover insights and smarter solutions for navigating an increasingly complex global environment.
  
  
**Work you’ll do**
As a Business Analyst, you’ll be tasked with creating documentation including requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, feature description, PowerPoint decks, user guides, process flows, wireframes and newsletters.
  
  
Additional responsibilities include:
  
  

* Assisting the Product Owner in leading, directing, and reviewing all activities associated with delivering technology products.
* Ability to work collaboratively with Tax Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) and technical teams and project managers on development projects during all phases of software development life cycle
* Responsible for conducting Design Thinking sessions to gain insights into application user needs, Manages the Product Backlog for a Product, working with the Product Owner to prioritize requirements, define and manage scope and sprints for a project.
* Provides operational support to tax practitioners. Engages with various teams to resolve problems as they arise.

**Teams**
Deloitte Tax LLP’s Tax Transformation (TTO) team is responsible for the design, development, and deployment of tax tools for the US Tax Practice. The professionals on the TTO team are focused on assisting Deloitte Tax in its efforts to deliver quality, comprehensive, value-added, and efficient client services using tax tools to our clients. The team consults and executes on a wide range of initiatives involving tax technology management, tool development and implementation.
  
  
**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s/Master’s degree in Computer Science or Business Administration, or relevant educational or professional experience
* 6-9 years of related experience in related field. Tax industry experience is a plus.
* Good to have accreditation such as BA Certification.
* Advanced written, verbal analytical and communications skills required.
* Strong interpersonal and relationship skills
* Basic client interaction skills
* Ability to coordinate and work effectively with teammates, end-users and leadership.

**Preferred/Plus:**

* Working knowledge of analytics, Alteryx, PowerBI.
* Data management, statistics, accounting, and computer applications
* Knowledge and experience with tax compliance systems or financial systems

**Our purpose**
Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.
  
  
**Our people and culture**
Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients’ most complex challenges. This makes Deloitte one of the most rewarding places to work.
  
  
**Professional development**
At Deloitte, professionals have the opportunity to work with some of the best and discover what works best for them. Here, we prioritize professional growth, offering diverse learning and networking opportunities to help accelerate careers and enhance leadership skills. Our state-of-the-art DU: The Leadership Center in India, located in Hyderabad, represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to the holistic growth and development of our people. Explore DU: The Leadership Center in India .
  
  
**Benefits To Help You Thrive**
At Deloitte, we know that great people make a great organization. Our comprehensive rewards program helps us deliver a distinctly Deloitte experience that helps that empowers our professionals to thrive mentally, physically, and financially—and live their purpose. To support our professionals and their loved ones, we offer a broad range of benefits. Eligibility requirements may be based on role, tenure, type of employment and/ or other criteria. Learn more about what working at Deloitte can mean for you.

From developing a stand out resume to putting your best foot forward in the interview, we want you to feel prepared and confident as you explore opportunities at Deloitte. Check out recruiting tips from Deloitte recruiters.

**Description**
We are seeking a proactive and experienced Senior Business Analyst to join our technology team.
  
  
The ideal candidate will have an MBA in Information Technology or Business Analytics and a strong understanding of how to bridge business needs with technical solutions.
  
  
In this role, you will collaborate closely with global stakeholders, product owners, and technical teams to define business requirements, design process improvements,

* Collaborate with business stakeholders to gather, analyze, and document detailed business and functional requirements.

* Facilitate workshops and meetings to elicit requirements, define scope, and align expectations between business and IT teams.
* Support the full Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) from requirement analysis through design, testing, deployment, and post-implementation review.
* Participate actively in Agile ceremonies (sprint planning, backlog grooming, daily stand-ups, reviews, and retrospectives).
* Support User Acceptance Testing (UAT) by developing test scenarios, tracking defects, and validating fixes.

* Partner with developers, QA engineers, and project managers to ensure technical solutions meet business expectations.

* Excellent communication, documentation, and stakeholder management skills.
* Proficiency in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint) and collaboration tools like JIRA and Confluence.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and work effectively in cross-functional teams.
* Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills.
* Working proficiency with Camtasia and Microsoft Clipchamp for recording, editing, captioning, and publishing clear business and product communication videos.
* Practical understanding of generative AI, large language models, prompt design, AI-assisted analysis, and the limitations of AI-generated outputs in a business environment.
* Ability to define AI-focused business requirements, use cases, user stories, acceptance criteria, process controls, and success measures while maintaining requirement traceability.
* Strong judgment in reviewing AI-generated content for accuracy, completeness, bias, privacy, security, and alignment with business intent.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Hands-on project experience in Business Analysis, Process Configuration, and Quote-to-Cash or Procure-to-Pay domains.
* Experience in process modeling tools and creating UML diagrams.
* Exposure to Configure, Price, Quote (CPQ) workflows.
* Experience in data-driven decision-making using Power BI, Tableau, or equivalent tools.
* Certifications such as CBAP, CCBA, or PMI-PBA are a plus.
* Hands-on experience using enterprise AI assistants or copilots to support analysis, documentation, research, meeting synthesis, and stakeholder communication.
* Exposure responsible for AI, AI governance, data privacy, security, explainability, human-in-the-loop controls, and risk assessment for AI-enabled solutions.
* Experience supporting AI or automation initiatives from business case development through requirements, testing, adoption, and benefits realization.
* Experience creating concise video tutorials, solution walkthroughs, release communications, or learning content for global stakeholders.

**Soft Skills**

* Excellent interpersonal and stakeholder engagement abilities.

Amazon's Verification & Risk Management Operations (VRMO) mission is to make Amazon the safest and most trusted place worldwide to transact online, either by identifying and reporting bad actors or mitigating risk and adhering to compliance laws and regulations according to market-specific, regional, or global direction. Amazon runs one of the most dynamic online platforms, encompassing dozens of global products with compliance requirements, including, Amazon Marketplace with over 2 million sellers worldwide selling hundreds of millions of items in eleven countries, Amazon Pay and MTurk.
  
  
BAR designs and builds the inspection systems, risk models and operational processes that minimise risk and maximise trust across Amazon's global product surface area, by ensuring every transaction and entity is compliant.
  
  
We are looking for a highly analytical and result-oriented Business Analyst who can analyse business decisions, troubleshoot issues, and communicate the findings effectively across different teams while raising the technical bar of the globally distributed analytics team, providing data wrangling expertise, deep understanding of data fundamentals, working with and synthesising very large datasets.
  
  
We utilise multiple externally and internally (AWS and other) developed data platforms, including real-time and close to real-time platforms, to help create signal out of the mountains of data.
  
  
Using LLMs will be critical requirement for this role as it needs experimentation and agent experience.
  
  
Our ideal analyst is one who enjoys discovering and solving complicated problems, can quickly learn complex systems, likes to work with numbers, and takes pride in organising and communicating his work. You should have the technical experience and knowledge to work comfortably using SQL, QuickSight/Tableau/PowerBI and scripting languages (Python/JavaScript) Additionally experience with designing data schemas that will allow you, and colleagues, which include Business Intelligence Engineers and Data Engineers to make sense of the vast datasets we possess.

* Organisation skills – demonstrated ability to work independently to make complex investigations, has self-discipline, is diligent and can manage time appropriately.

Using LLMs and Agents for efficiency improvement

* Experience defining requirements and using data and metrics to draw business insights

* Experience with Excel

jobs.title: Group Product Manager, Physical AI & Robotics
jobs.description:
**Who We Are**
--------------

Welcome to TELUS Digital — where innovation drives impact at a global scale. As an award-winning digital product consultancy and the digital division of TELUS, one of Canada’s largest telecommunications providers, we design and deliver transformative customer experiences through cutting-edge technology, agile thinking, and a people-first culture.

With a global team across North America, South America, Central America, Europe, Africa, and APAC, we offer end-to-end expertise across various service offerings: Web, Mobile & Digital Marketing | Enterprise AI | Customer Care AI & Technology | Enterprise Technology Modernization

From mobile apps and websites to voice UI, chatbots, AI, customer service, and in-store solutions, TELUS Digital enables seamless, trusted, and digitally powered experiences that meet customers wherever they are — all backed by the secure infrastructure and scale of our multi-billion-dollar parent company.

**Location & Flexibility**
--------------------------

**India Hybrid: Bengaluru**
---------------------------

This is a hybrid role. This model requires the ability to work in a hybrid mode from our office in Bengaluru(2 to 3 times/ week). Our office culture is designed to foster in-person innovation, collaboration, and connection with team members, local and visiting, from other global offices.

**The Opportunity**
-------------------

Robotics foundation models need millions of hours of dense, real-world data—and simulation alone won't cut it. TELUS Digital is solving the Physical AI bottleneck, capturing highly calibrated, real-world data at scale across hundreds of devices to power the world's leading hyperscalers.

We are hiring a **Group Product Manager** for the **Physical AI Robotics product team**. You will own the tooling this runs on: capture applications, operator workflows, session management, review and QA, and customer delivery. You will work with the researchers consuming the data and the operators producing it, and the standards you set will carry into how the industry does this.

Your application will stand out if you are demonstrably curious and have side work projects to showcase.

**Responsibilities:**
---------------------

* 8-12 years in product management, including at least 2 in robotics, physical AI, AR/VR, autonomous systems, or data collection at scale.
* Own the roadmap for robotics data collection, setting direction and driving execution across engineering, design, operations, quality, and solutions.
* Assess demand for new capture modalities, then define the collection model, hardware, and tooling.
* Work with engineering and design on the operator experience: onboarding, task guidance, in-session feedback, error states, review workflows. Operators work one-handed, in motion, wearing a headset, or against a clock.
* Build prototypes and write the specs. Requirements and user stories that hold up under engineering review.
* Translate customer model requirements into collection designs, and evolving research into quality standards for egocentric data: pose accuracy, sync tolerance, occlusion handling, annotation schema, acceptance criteria.
* Spend time with collectors, session leads, and reviewers. When data underperforms in training, trace it back to the capture design or the tooling that produced it.
* Represent the product directly to hyperscaler and robotics foundation model teams, and bring their constraints back into the roadmap.
* Optimize for yield per session, rejection rate, cost per usable hour, capture-to-delivery time, and operator retention.
* Champion pilots as the default way to test a change. Small cohort, clear hypothesis, fixed window. Scale what works and stop what does not.

jobs.description:
**About Procucev-**

Procucev is a B2B procurement platform. Buyers raise RFQs for industrial and commercial supplies through our two products — Get My Quote (GMT) and Buy From Stock (BFS) — and verified sellers buy credit packages to access those RFQs and quote on them. We are relaunching the business with a sharp three-month target: more qualified buyer RFQs, and more sellers paying to reach them. Inside sales is where both numbers are won or lost every day.

**What you'll do-**

**Run the calling floor (this is what you'll be measured on):**

* Lead the telecalling team day to day — daily targets, call lists, scripts, call reviews, and a stand-up every morning.
* Drive buyer-side outcomes: buyer registrations, first RFQs, and repeat RFQs from our existing buyer base.
* Drive seller-side conversions over the phone: turn registered sellers into paying subscribers on our 50-credit package, and renewals when credits run low.
* Qualify and route: pass larger buyers and high-potential sellers to the Business Development Manager with clean notes, not just a name.

**Process and pipeline:**

* Build call scripts, objection-handling notes, and WhatsApp/email follow-up templates for each segment — and rewrite them when the numbers say they aren't working.
* Work leads coming in from email (Apollo), SMS, WhatsApp, Google Ads, and website forms within the same working day.
* Keep the pipeline honest in our CRM / tracker: every call logged, every stage updated, no "interested" leads left untouched for a week.
* Report weekly on calls made, connects, registrations, RFQs raised, seller conversions, and revenue — with the reasons behind the misses.

**Team building:**

* Help hire, onboard, and coach callers and interns; listen to recorded calls and give specific feedback.
* Spot patterns from the floor — which categories, cities, and buyer types convert — and feed them back to marketing.

**What we're looking for-**

* 4–10 years in inside sales, tele-sales, or a call-centre-led B2B sales role, including leading or coaching a team of callers.
* Experience selling to Indian SMEs, manufacturers, traders, or suppliers. B2B marketplace or SaaS subscription experience is a strong plus.
* A track record you can put a number on: conversions, revenue, or team targets hit.
* Fluent English and Hindi; working Kannada, Telugu, or Tamil is a real advantage for our seller base.
* Comfortable with CRMs, Google Sheets, and WhatsApp Business — you will live in the data.
* Calm under daily targets, and direct enough to tell the team (and us) what isn't working. Good to have
* Exposure to industrial categories — MRO, electricals, packaging, raw materials, fabrication.
* Experience with dialers, call recording, or tools like Zoho CRM, LeadSquared, or HubSpot.

**Why this role-**

* You own a number that directly decides whether the relaunch works.
* Direct line to the Business Head — your floor insights shape strategy, not just scripts.
* Small team, fast decisions, visible impact.

Pay: ₹500,000.00 - ₹1,000,000.00 per year

Work Location: In person
