**Product Owner**

*Accelerate Performance.*

**About CAI Software**

CAI Software builds purpose-built solutions that help manufacturers, processors, and distributors accelerate performance. Our mission is to enable manufacturers to transform performance through a connected, AI-assisted ecosystem that delivers visibility, control, and continuous improvement. We bring the deep operational expertise and enterprise infrastructure to be a true long-term performance partner.

We work across 15+ industries and 10+ countries, guided by three values built into our name: Candor, Accountability, and Impact.

**CAI Business Units and the Markets We Serve**

CAI Software is organized into three business units: Graphic Communications, Process Manufacturing, and Discrete Manufacturing - aligned to the industries we serve. This structure keeps our teams close to customer needs while operating with the scale and support of a global software company.

This role is part of our
**Discrete Manufacturing**
business unit, which delivers software solutions for manufacturers that produce components and assemblies that become part of larger products. Serving small through enterprise manufacturers in industries such as aerospace, automotive, industrial equipment, and engineered products, Discrete Manufacturing focuses on modern execution-connecting planning, production, traceability, and automation to help manufacturers run more resilient, efficient, and predictable operations.

**CAI India**

CAI India is a strategic investment in the company's future. Our Bangalore Center of Excellence is a place of ownership, expertise, and accountability. Teams in India work on global products end to end, contribute to key decisions, and influence how CAI evolves as a business. This is not a support-led model, but rather a center designed to lead through knowledge, responsibility, and trust.

**About the Role**

The Product Owner will operate within our AI-DLC (AI-Driven Development Lifecycle) model, partnering with Product Management, Engineering, and AI coding agents (Claude, Gemini, OpenAI-based tools) to translate manufacturing and customer needs into precise specs and intents that AI agents can implement directly. Rather than authoring only traditional user stories, this role owns Spec-Driven Development (SDD) for the team — writing unambiguous specifications, reviewing AI-generated plans and code before execution proceeds, and making the human judgment calls that AI-DLC defers to people. This is a hands-on execution role focused on driving agentic delivery of MES capabilities that improve shop-floor efficiency, visibility, and control, while maintaining human oversight and accountability at every stage of the AI-DLC cycle.

Location

* Bangalore, India – Hybrid In Office

Responsibilities

* Own the MES product backlog as a set of AI-DLC intents and units of work, ensuring each is scoped precisely enough for agentic execution within a delivery cycle (bolt).
* Translate high-level MES product strategy into precise specs, acceptance criteria, and workflows detailed enough for AI agents to implement directly.
* Work closely with Engineering, QA, and UX — often in mob-programming/pod sessions with AI agents — to refine specs, clarify requirements, and remove ambiguity before and during delivery cycles.
* Review and validate AI-generated plans, user stories, and implementation proposals before execution proceeds, acting as the human decision-maker in the AI-DLC oversight loop.
* Make day-to-day scope, priority, and risk-acceptance decisions for the team, deferring to Engineering only the technical calls AI-DLC reserves for specialists.
* Define acceptance criteria and evaluation checks ("evals") that AI agents and QA use to verify completed work against business intent, and provide timely feedback and sign-off.
* Collaborate with stakeholders (Product Management, Implementation, Support, Customer Success) to translate plant and user feedback into new specs and backlog priorities.
* Monitor MES usage, defects, and AI-DLC cycle metrics to identify improvements and incremental value opportunities, feeding learnings back into specs.
* Maintain transparency on team progress, AI-generated changes, risks, and dependencies through clear communication and reporting.
* Ability to build Product markdown files to provide AI agents contextual background to the MES product.

Required Qualifications

* 4–7 years of experience in a Product Owner, Business Analyst, or similar role on software development teams.
* Hands-on experience with LLM tools such as Claude, Gemini, or OpenAI, used in a professional product or development context.
* Working knowledge of Spec-Driven Development (SDD) — able to write specs precise enough for AI agents to implement directly.
* Strong experience writing user stories/Intents, defining acceptance criteria, and managing backlogs in tools like Jira or Azure DevOps.
* Solid understanding of software methodologies (Scrum or Kanban) and how to adapt them to agentic, AI-DLC-based delivery.
* Ability to understand technical concepts relevant to MES (APIs, integrations with ERP/PLM/SCADA, data models) and communicate effectively with both engineers and AI agents.

Preferred Qualifications

* Familiarity with AI-DLC (AI-Driven Development Lifecycle) methodology is a plus.
* AI & Technical Fluency — comfortable evaluating AI-generated code, plans, and test coverage well enough to approve or redirect them.
* Experience with AI-DLC & agentic delivery — working in mob-programming/pod formats with cross-functional teams and AI coding agents.
* Data-driven product management — using shopfloor KPIs, usage analytics, and AI-DLC cycle metrics to shape backlog priorities.

jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.description:
About Aerchain (Why Us?)

We’re rewriting the rules of procurement with an AI-first platform that powers $20B+ in enterprise spend.

From $4M ARR today to $25M ARR and beyond, our mission is to build enterprise-grade, AI-first procurement software for global enterprises across manufacturing, FMCG, and services.

Role Snapshot

You’ll own a cluster of modules and be accountable for the outcomes they drive across customers. You’ll work with enterprise clients to ensure they realise value from the product, lead solutioning for complex accounts, define what the cluster builds and why, and ensure every module delivers measurable customer value. You’ll work across business, engineering, and leadership, and develop the PMs / Builders in your cluster. You set the

standard for how the cluster builds: solutions are prototyped in AI, and engineering builds forward from those prototypes rather than from a blank page. You report to the Product Lead.

Role Snapshot

You’ll own one or more modules end-to-end, not just the backlog, but the customer outcomes those modules drive. You’ll run customer engagements independently, work closely with business and engineering teams, and be the single point of authority for what gets built, deferred, and why. You don’t take requirements; you diagnose problems and prescribe solutions. You don’t just spec the build; you start it: you prototype the solution in AI, and engineering builds forward from what you’ve made rather than from a blank page. You report to a Principal PM / Lead Builder or a Senior PM / Senior Builder.

What You’ll Drive

Problem Discovery & Research

* Own customer engagements end-to-end: understand their problems, workflows, and success criteria well enough to prescribe, not just specify.
* Analyse data and signals to validate and size problems. Know the problem better than the customer does.
* Zero escalations without a recommended path and supporting reasoning.

Customer Ownership

* Own Tier B or Tier C customer engagements end-to-end, from understanding their problems to ensuring they realise value from the product.
* Solution customers independently, coordinating with other PMs / Builders where modules overlap.
* Be the single point of contact for your customers, not just during delivery, but through adoption and outcome validation.

Solutioning & Prototyping

* Define what gets built, deferred, and killed, with reasoning tied to customer outcomes, not stakeholder volume.
* Write PRDs that engineering can build from without constant clarification: scenarios, edge cases, and acceptance criteria all present before grooming.
* Build working prototypes in AI, not throwaway mockups. Your prototype is the foundation engineering builds forward from: developers extend the backend, harden it, and refine functionality from what you’ve already built. A large part of the build happens in your hands.
* Use AI across every step: research, problem framing, drafting, prototyping, validation.

Execution & Delivery

* Own sprint delivery for your modules. Coordinate across engineering and business teams. Unblock issues before they become delays.
* Ensure milestone testing and validation happens before release. Own the quality bar for your modules.

Release & Adoption

* Define and track customer-value metrics for your modules, metrics that answer: is this module making procurement measurably better?
* Own post-release adoption. A shipped feature with no adoption is a failure you own.

You’ll thrive here if

* 4–6 years in product roles with demonstrated module or feature ownership.
* You diagnose problems from first principles and prescribe solutions; you don’t take requirements and execute.
* You use AI as a core part of how you work, not occasionally, but across every step of discovery, solutioning, and delivery, including building the prototype engineering carries forward.
* You make decisions in ambiguity with reasoning. You don’t escalate problems, you escalate recommendations.
* You think in outcomes, not outputs. You know the difference between shipping and delivering value.
* Bonus: exposure to enterprise SaaS, complex B2B environments, or procurement tech.

What’s In It For You

* Full module ownership on a platform that processes $20B+ in enterprise spend.
* Direct engagement with enterprise customers: you own their outcomes, not just their tickets.
* Work with a team that has chosen to move first on AI: you’ll be operating at a level most product teams won’t reach for years.
* A culture where problem solving, ownership, and action are rewarded, and the opposite is called out.

Ready to build Aerchain’s future?

If reimagining business engines with AI and solving problems at scale excites you, let’s talk. Apply now and help us build the most agile enterprise SaaS story in the world.

At Nielsen, we are passionate about our work to power a better media future for all people by providing powerful insights that drive client decisions and deliver extraordinary results. Our talented, global workforce is dedicated to capturing audience engagement with content - wherever and whenever it’s consumed. Together, we are proudly rooted in our deep legacy as we stand at the forefront of the media revolution. When you join Nielsen, you will join a dynamic team committed to excellence, perseverance, and the ambition to make an impact together. We champion you, because when you succeed, we do too. We enable your best to power our future.
  
  
**Job Description**
Gracenote's Data Platform is the central hub for millions of pieces of TV entertainment data used daily by clients and partners worldwide. It provides the critical services that structure and model data for our editorial, ingest, and delivery systems. This data powers entertainment solutions for the top cable, OTT, CE, and digital clients, reaching hundreds of millions of consumers.
  
  
We are hiring a lead product manager to own this platform from our Bengaluru engineering center. The role also owns Gracenote's content-source-facing products, the Gracenote ID Distribution System (GNIDS) and Gracenote View, through which content owners register content, obtain Gracenote IDs, submit first-party metadata, and access Gracenote data. This role has a deliberate arc.
  
  
Initially, this is a hands-on role. You will write specs and requirements yourself, work directly with engineers and data architects, analyze data with your own queries, and build deep fluency in the platform. We are looking for someone senior who still genuinely enjoys this work.
  
  
As the platform and your fluency mature, the role expands into a player-coach position, which will build and mentor a product team in India while remaining close to the platform. Candidates should be excited by both halves of this trajectory, not just the second one.
  
  
You will be the lead product presence co-located with our engineering organization, partnering across time zones with Dataset and Delivery Product Managers and commercial stakeholders based in the US and Europe. This is not a satellite role. It is the product anchor for our engineering center.
  
  
An ideal candidate will have 8+ years of Product Management experience and a proven track record of end-to-end ownership and delivering results.

* Own the product vision, roadmap, and delivery for Gracenote's Data Platform, the system that structures and models complex TV entertainment data for internal consumers and clients alike.
* Own the Gracenote ID Distribution System (GNIDS) and Gracenote View, including requirements, backlog, delivery, and support for existing customers and partner integrations. Define how these products evolve as the platform matures.
* Work closely with Global Dataset and Delivery Product Managers to understand the business problems in creating and structuring complex entertainment data, and translate those needs into a clear, prioritized roadmap.
* Partner directly with engineering teams and Data Architects to shape data models, write detailed requirements, and drive hands-on execution, especially in the first phase of the role.
* Define and own the platform's key input and output metrics. Establish platform SLAs and quality measures, and publish them so internal and external consumers can hold the platform accountable.
* Operate effectively across a globally distributed organization: strong async written communication, disciplined documentation, and willingness to flex hours for overlap with US/EU stakeholders.
* Over time, hire, mentor, and grow a high-performing product team in India while remaining an active individual contributor on the most complex platform problems.

**Qualifications**

* 8+ years of product management experience, including 3+ years on platform or data products.

* Experience owning client-facing web applications or APIs alongside a data platform.
* Experience partnering with Data Architects to shape complex business data into coherent, extensible, scalable structures.
* Prior experience as a hiring manager or formal people manager.
* Comfortable with XML, JSON, SQL, and REST APIs; able to write or LLM-assist your own scripts in Python or SQL to answer product questions.

* Highly metrics-driven: able to distill a complex platform into a small set of key input and output metrics and use them to drive decisions.

jobs.title: Sr Data Analyst
jobs.description:
About the Role  
  
Join the **Data Analytics (DA)** team at **TII** across domains such as **Marketing and Digital, Merchandising, Supply Chain and Logistics, Store Operations, Finance** and more**.** Here you'll collaborate with business leaders to turn data into insights that drive strategic decisions. You’ll be part of a fast-moving, high-impact environment focused on leveraging business intelligence and advanced analytics to solve real-world problems.  
This role combines technical expertise with business understanding to uncover and communicate actionable insights using cutting-edge statistical and analytical techniques.  
  
Behind one of the world’s best loved brands is a uniquely capable and brilliant team of data scientists, engineers and analysts. The Target Data & Analytics team creates the tools and data products to sustainably educate and enable our business partners to make great data-based decisions at Target. We help develop the technology that personalizes the guest experience, from product recommendations to relevant ad content. We’re also the source of the data and analytics behind Target’s Internet of Things (iOT) applications, fraud detection, Supply Chain optimization and demand forecasting. We play a key role in identifying the test-and-measure or A/B test opportunities that continuously help Target improve the guest experience, whether they love to shop in stores or at Target.com.

Key Responsibilities:  
 Translate business problems into well-defined analytical questions and structured  
approaches  
 Support scenario, decision, and action modelling to evaluate business trade-offs and  
inform recommended actions  
 Partner with Target business stakeholders to understand priorities and roadmaps,  
validate analytical requirements, and present insights and recommendations with clarity  
and impact  
 Develop and deliver analytical and AI-driven solutions (including GenAI, Agent, and  
Agentic approaches) that enable decision support, forecasting, optimization, and  
automation  
 Apply advanced analytics techniques, including causal, predictive, and prescriptive  
analytics, to drive deeper understanding of business levers and inform optimal actions  
 Work with large-scale datasets using platforms such as GCP BigQuery, Spark, and SQL-  
based data warehouses; build and maintain reliable data pipelines using Airflow or  
similar orchestration tools  
 Contribute to AI-driven analytical workflows, defining quality metrics (e.g., accuracy,  
relevance), assessing reliability, and measuring tangible business impact  
 Ensure analytical outputs are accurate, scalable, and aligned with business context  
 Develop strong data storytelling skills to communicate insights and recommendations to  
non-technical audiences  
 Document analytical methodologies, assumptions, and outputs to support reuse and  
knowledge sharing  
 Adhere to corporate data protection standards and responsible AI practices  
Requirements / About You:  
Experience: Overall 5-8 years exp and relevant 3-5 years exp  
Qualification:  
TI : B.Tech / B.E. or Masters in Statistics /Econometrics/Mathematics equivalent  
US : BA/BS in a quantitative degree – Math, Statistics, Econometrics, Data  
Sciences, Computer Science or equivalent work experience  
Skills required:  
1. Extensive exposure to Structured Query Language (SQL), SQL Optimization and  
DW/BI concepts.  
2. Proven hands-on experience in BI Visualization tool (i.e. PBI, Looker, Tableau) with  
ability to learn additional vendor and proprietary visualizations tools.  
3. Strong knowledge of structured (i.e. Teradata, Oracle, Hive) and unstructured  
databases including Hadoop Distributed File System (HDFS). Exposure and extensive  
hands-on work with large data sets.  
4. Hands on experience in R, Python, Hive or other open-source languages/database  
5. Hands on experience in any advanced analytical techniques like Regression, Time-  
series models, Classification Techniques, etc. and conceptual understanding of all  
the techniques mentioned above  
6. Git source code management & experience working in an agile environment.  
7. Strong attention to detail, excellent diagnostic, and problem-solving skills  
8. Highly self-motivated with a strong sense of urgency to be able to work both  
independently and in team settings in a fast-paced environment; capability to  
manage urgency timelines  
9. Competent and curious to ask questions and learn to fill gaps, desire to teach and  
learn.  
10. Excellent communication, service orientation and strong relationship building skills  
11. Experience with Retail, Merchandising, Marketing will be strong addons  
12. Hands-on experience leveraging Generative AI (GenAI) and LLM-based solutions  
(e.g., prompt engineering, Retrieval-Augmented Generation – RAG) to enhance data  
analysis, automate insight generation, and support business decision-making  
13. Ability to integrate AI-driven tools and AI-agent workflows into end-to-end analytical  
processes, enabling automation, improving productivity, and scaling analytics use  
cases.

* Validate, profile, and check data quality to maintain accuracy

* 12+ years of experience
* Strong SQL skills for writing complex queries
* Solid understanding of Data Warehousing concepts
* Background in ETL processes and data transformation logic
* Hands-on experience in:

+ ETL processes and data transformation
+ Data mapping and S2T documentation
+ Integration design and documentation (ISD)

* Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities
* Excellent communication and documentation skills

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* In-depth knowledge of Talent processes, system functionalities, data integration methodologies, and best practices
* Proficiency in data analysis and tools, database query languages (e.g., SQL), and data visualization tools (e.g., Power BI)
* Strong analytical skills, with the ability to synthesize complex data into actionable insights
* Excellent documentation and presentation skills, with the ability to communicate complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders
* Strong project management capabilities, including the ability to lead and manage cross-functional teams
* Positive attitude, adaptability, and the ability to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment
* Results-oriented, with a focus on achieving project objectives and driving positive outcomes
* Strong negotiation and conflict resolution skills
* Ability to work virtually with global teams

**To qualify for this role**

* Bachelor's degree in a relevant field; additional certifications in business analysis or SAP SuccessFactors preferred
* Proven experience as a Senior Business Analyst with a focus on Talent systems, SAP SuccessFactors, and data integration
* As a Senior Business Analyst, 8 to 10 years of industry experience with exposure to Talent management, HR systems, workforce analytics, or people data initiatives.

**Nice to have**

* SuccessFactors knowledge.
* Understanding of Databricks.

**What We Offer**

* Dynamic teamwork: You’ll work with brilliant and innovative professionals who are devoted to building a better working world.
* Continuous learning: You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next
* Success as defined by you: We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way
* Transformative leadership: We’ll give the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs
* Diverse and inclusive culture: You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.

The purpose of the role is to liaison and bridging the gap between customer and Wipro delivery team to comprehend and analyze customer requirements and articulating aptly to delivery teams thereby, ensuring right solutioning to the customer.

͏

jobs.title: Business Analyst
jobs.description:
**About Us**
At ANZ, we're shaping a world where people and communities thrive, driven by a common goal: to improve the financial wellbeing and sustainability of our millions of customers.
  
  
**About The Role**
As a Business Analyst in Transformation Delivery Hub, you’ll play a key role in accelerating delivery of projects and programs, by gathering and clarifying requirements, analysing processes, and translating business objectives into actionable specifications for delivery teams, whilst aligning with stakeholder expectations to add real value.
  
  
The
**Business Analyst**
leads business analysis activities for medium-complexity initiatives, workstreams and cross-functional change programs. The role is responsible for investigating business problems, evaluating solution options, managing requirements, and driving process improvements to deliver measurable business outcomes. Working with a broad range of stakeholders, the analyst translates business needs into actionable solutions, influences decision-making and ensures alignment between business objectives and delivery outcomes. They operate with a high degree of independence and are expected to mentor junior analysts, contribute to BA best practices and support successful change adoption.
  
  
Banking is changing and we’re changing with it, giving our people great opportunities to try new things, learn and grow. Whatever your role at ANZ, you’ll be building your future, while helping to build ours.
  
  
**Role Type:**
Permanent
  
  
**Role Location**
: Acacia, Manyata Tech Park
  
  
**Work Hours**
: 7.00 am to 4.00 pm
  
  
**Note 1:**
The standard work schedule for this role is 7:00 AM to 4:00 PM. However, candidates are expected to remain flexible and may be required to work earlier shifts, depending on project commitments and scheduled stakeholder engagements or meetings.
  
  
**Note 2:**
There are multiple vacancies available for this role. Successful candidates may be matched to any of the available positions based on their experience, skills and business needs.
  
  
**What will your day look like?**
As a Business Analyst, you will:
  
  

* Lead the analysis of complex business situations to identify root causes, opportunities, risks and recommendations for improvement.
* Conduct feasibility assessments and evaluate solution options by analysing business impacts, costs, benefits, risks and strategic alignment.
* Own end-to-end requirements management activities for medium-complexity initiatives, including elicitation, prioritisation, traceability and change management.
* Facilitate stakeholder workshops and discussions to build alignment, resolve competing priorities and support informed decision-making.
* Develop and maintain business, process and data models that support business understanding, solution design and strategic decision-making.
* Analyse current and future-state business processes and identify opportunities to improve efficiency, effectiveness, customer outcomes and operational performance.
* Support development of business cases, benefits measures and value realisation approaches to ensure successful business outcomes.
* Lead solution validation activities, including acceptance criteria definition, UAT oversight and business sign-off activities.
* Assess business impacts arising from process, technology or organisational change and support implementation and adoption activities.
* Apply and promote organisational methods, standards, tools and governance practices to deliver consistent, high-quality analysis outcomes.

**What will you bring?**
To grow and be successful in this role, you will ideally bring the following:
  
  

* Business Analysis & Problem Solving like business situation analysis, root cause analysis, solution evaluation
* Requirements Management including elicitation, prioritisation, traceability, change management
* Business Process & Data Analysis and suggesting process improvements,
* Business and data modelling
* Facilitation and Influencing including negotiation and conflict resolution
* Solution validation and testing including UAT oversight and business sign off
* Agile and Waterfall delivery methodologies
* Process modelling tools (Visio, BPMN, data modelling or equivalent

You’re not expected to have 100% of these skills. At ANZ a growth mindset is at the heart of our culture, so if you have most of these things in your toolbox, we’d love to hear from you.
  
  
**So why join us? (Bengaluru GCC)**
ANZ is a place where big things happen as we work together to provide banking and financial services across more than 30 markets. With more than 7,500 people, our Bengaluru team is the bank's largest technology, data and operations centre outside Australia. In operation for over 33 years, the centre is critical in delivering the bank's strategy and making an impact for our millions of customers around the world. Our Bengaluru team not only drives the transformation initiatives of the bank, it also drives a culture that makes ANZ a great place to be. We're proud that people feel they can be themselves at ANZ and 90 percent of our people feel they belong.
  
  
We know our people need different things to be great in their role, so we offer a range of flexible working options, including hybrid work (where the role allows it). Our people also enjoy a range of benefits including access to health and wellbeing services.
  
  
We want to continue building a diverse workplace and welcome applications from everyone. Please talk to us about any adjustments you may require to our recruitment process or the role itself. If you are a candidate with a disability or access requirements, let us know how we can provide you with additional support.
  
  
To find out more about working at ANZ visit https://www.anz.com/careers/. You can apply for this role by visiting ANZ Careers and searching for reference number 126475.
  
  
**Job Posting End Date**
27/10/2026, 11.59pm, (Melbourne Australia)

msg global is a consulting and system integration company with a strong focus on the insurance and reinsurance industry. We support our clients in designing, transforming, and implementing integrated IT architectures across end‑to‑end business processes. With deep industry expertise, we deliver high‑quality SAP‑based solutions tailored to the specific requirements of insurance and reinsurance organizations.
  
  
**What You Will Do**
As a Business Analyst, you will collaborate closely with msg global project teams and customer stakeholders to deliver SAP for reinsurance implementations. Your responsibilities will include:
  
  

* Analyzing, specifying, testing, and documenting reinsurance business processes
* Designing integrated and sustainable system landscapes
* Participating in process flow analysis, redesign, and business process optimization
* Designing transition maps, roadmaps, implementation, integration, and migration strategies
* Providing functional consulting expertise to reinsurance clients

* Excellent knowledge of Reinsurance and insurance business processes, particularly for P&C lines of business

jobs.description:
**About Us**
At ANZ, we're shaping a world where people and communities thrive, driven by a common goal: to improve the financial wellbeing and sustainability of our millions of customers.
  
  
**About The Role**
As a Senior
*Business Analyst*
in Transformation Delivery Hub, you’ll play a key role in accelerating delivery of projects and programs
*, b*
y leading in requirements gathering, analysing processes, and translating business objectives into actionable specifications for delivery teams, whilst aligning with stakeholder expectations to add real value.
  
  
The Senior Business Analyst leads business analysis activities for large, complex and strategically significant initiatives that span multiple business units, products, systems or stakeholder groups. The role is responsible for shaping problem definition, driving requirements strategy, influencing solution direction and ensuring that change initiatives deliver measurable business value. Senior Business Analysts operate with a high degree of autonomy, navigating ambiguity, resolving competing stakeholder priorities and providing expert guidance throughout the change lifecycle. They are trusted advisors to project sponsors, business leaders and delivery teams, translating strategic objectives into actionable outcomes and ensuring alignment between business goals, customer needs and technology solutions.
  
  
Banking is changing and we’re changing with it, giving our people great opportunities to try new things, learn and grow. Whatever your role at ANZ, you’ll be building your future, while helping to build ours.
  
  
**Role Type: Permanent
  
  
Role Location: Acacia, Manyata Tech Park
  
  
Work Hours: 7.00 am to 4.00 pm**
**Note 1:**
The standard work schedule for this role is 7:00 AM to 4:00 PM. However, candidates are expected to remain flexible and may be required to work earlier shifts, depending on project commitments and scheduled stakeholder engagements or meetings.
  
  
**Note 2:**
There are multiple vacancies available for this role. Successful candidates may be matched to any of the available positions based on their experience, skills and business needs.
  
  
**What will your day look like?**
As a Senior Business Analyst, you will:
  
  

* Lead the analysis of complex business problems, opportunities and strategic initiatives, providing recommendations that support organisational decision-making and business outcomes.
* Assess solution options, feasibility, business impacts, risks, costs and benefits to support investment decisions and change initiatives.
* Lead end-to-end requirements strategy, governance and lifecycle management, ensuring alignment between business objectives, scope and delivery outcomes.
* Lead current-state and future-state analysis, identifying opportunities to improve business processes, customer outcomes, operating models and ways of working.
* Develop and maintain complex business, process and data models that support strategic planning, solution design and organisational transformation.
* Build trusted relationships with senior stakeholders and act as a strategic advisor, influencing decisions through evidence-based analysis and recommendations.
* Facilitate workshops, negotiations and decision-making forums to achieve alignment across business, technology and delivery stakeholders.
* Provide leadership and oversight for solution validation, acceptance testing, business readiness and implementation activities to ensure successful delivery outcomes. Lead change impact assessments and benefits realisation.
* Coach and mentor Business Analysts, providing guidance, quality assurance and support to uplift business analysis capability across teams and programs.
* Contribute to the development and continuous improvement of business analysis frameworks, standards, methodologies, tools and governance practices.

**What will you bring?**
To grow and be successful in this role, you will ideally bring the following:
  
  

* Strategic Business Analysis & Problem Solving like business situation analysis, root cause analysis, solution evaluation
* Requirements Leadership and governance including requirements strategy, scope management and prioritisation
* Business Process & Data Analysis and suggesting process improvements
* Business case development and benefits management and realisation
* Executive/Senior Stakeholder engagement and relationship management
* Facilitation and Influencing including negotiation, conflict resolution and decision support
* Business transformation and process improvement including future state thinking
* Process modelling tools (Advanced modelling techniques using Visio, BPMN, data modelling or equivalent)

You’re not expected to have 100% of these skills. At ANZ a growth mindset is at the heart of our culture, so if you have most of these things in your toolbox, we’d love to hear from you.
  
  
**So why join us? (Bengaluru GCC)**
ANZ is a place where big things happen as we work together to provide banking and financial services across more than 30 markets. With more than 7,500 people, our Bengaluru team is the bank's largest technology, data and operations centre outside Australia. In operation for over 33 years, the centre is critical in delivering the bank's strategy and making an impact for our millions of customers around the world. Our Bengaluru team not only drives the transformation initiatives of the bank, it also drives a culture that makes ANZ a great place to be. We're proud that people feel they can be themselves at ANZ and 90 percent of our people feel they belong.
  
  
We know our people need different things to be great in their role, so we offer a range of flexible working options, including hybrid work (where the role allows it). Our people also enjoy a range of benefits including access to health and wellbeing services.
  
  
We want to continue building a diverse workplace and welcome applications from everyone. Please talk to us about any adjust…
